The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application management, assessment workflows, award administration, post-award monitoring, reporting, and integration with the Arts Council’s existing Finance Management System. This approach is intended to validate vendor capability, system performance, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. Background and Objective The Arts Council is undertaking the replacement of its existing Grant Management System (GMS), a critical business application that underpins the administration, assessment, award, and ongoing management of public funding programmes.
